metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.version_rule: Optimistic writes bind to an explicit expected version/hash/revision where required.
semantics.conflict_rule: Expected-versus-current mismatch produces an explicit conflict, not last-write-wins unless that policy is explicitly declared.
semantics.merge_rule: Conflict merge/reconciliation is a separate explicit operation with provenance.
semantics.lock_rule: Locks, where used, have explicit owner/scope/lifetime and release semantics.
semantics.identity_rule: Record identity and record version/revision identity remain distinct.
semantics.retry_rule: Automatic retry is bounded and may only reapply when semantics remain valid under the declared profile.
semantics.order_rule: mtime, arrival order or filesystem order never establishes authority by itself.
semantics.authority_rule: Winning a concurrency race does not substitute for authorization.

invariants.rule: Every DWH mutation resolves an exact destination instance/schema/record/field identity, validates intended change, evaluates authorization and conflict state, and records provenance; no write is inferred from query/display context or silently overwrites conflicting accepted state.

hard_gates.condition: stale writer silently overwrites current state
record revision used as record semantic identity

references.purpose: Conflicts enter explicit reconciliation when needed.
